user_saw: With newline chunking enabled, formatted Signal replies could combine paragraphs that should have arrived in separate messages.
summary: The fix applies the configured chunk mode to formatted Signal sends and groups paragraphs before computing style ranges.
reasoning: The oldest available source already routes formatted Signal replies through a formatter that receives a size limit and table mode but no chunk mode, bypassing the plain-text chunking path. The July outbound recovery change preserved that routing, and the offline history lookup stopped at a missing parent, so I could not verify when the bypass was introduced or whether newline chunking had previously worked for those replies.
